| **March 17** | Friday | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan) | Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan | Long weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun). |
| **April 7** | Friday | Good Friday | All provinces | Long weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun). |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | All provinces | Long weekend (Mon‑Tue‑Wed). |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | All provinces | No long weekend (holiday on Saturday). |
| **September 4** | Monday | Labour Day | All provinces | Long weekend (Mon‑Tue‑Wed). |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving | All provinces | Long weekend (Mon‑Tue‑Wed). |
| **November 10** | Friday | Remembrance Day (observed) | All provinces | Long weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun). |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | All provinces | Long weekend (Mon‑Tue‑Wed). |

2. **Calendar integration** – Mark the dates above as “public holiday” events in your calendar view.  
3. **User notifications** – Send reminders a few days before each long weekend so users can plan their trips.
